extName.message: Decant - In-Browser Document & Web Page to Markdown for AI, Cut Token Cost
extName.description: Extension name as listed on the Chrome Web Store (75-character limit). "Decant" is the product name and stays untranslated.

extNameShort.message: Decant - Documents & Web Pages to Markdown
extNameShort.description: Shorter extension name for addons.mozilla.org, which rejects names over 45 characters. Must stay within 45 characters in every locale.

extDescription.message: Convert PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML & web pages to Markdown before uploading to LLM chats - cut token cost, in-browser.
extDescription.description: Store listing description. Limited to 132 characters by both stores.

actionTitle.message: Decant this page to your last-used chat
actionTitle.description: Toolbar button tooltip, and the description of the keyboard shortcut that does the same thing. "Decant" is used as a verb here — the product name doubles as the action.

optionsTitle.description: Title of the options page browser tab.

optionsTagline.message: Convert files to Markdown before they upload.
optionsTagline.description: One-line product summary under the heading on the options page.

optionsHostsHeading.description: Heading of the section listing the sites Decant is allowed to run on.

optionsHostsHint.message: Decant does nothing on a site until you enable it here. Turning a host on asks Chrome for permission to run on that host.
optionsHostsHint.description: Explanation under the "Where Decant runs" heading.

optionsHostsAddPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the text box for adding a new site. "example.com" is a reserved example domain and should stay as-is.

optionsAdd.description: Button that adds the site or rule typed beside it.

optionsRemoveHost.description: Tooltip on the ✕ button that removes a site from the list.

optionsNeedsAccess.description: Button on an enabled site whose browser permission has gone missing. Clicking it asks for the permission again. Kept short — it sits inline in a list row.

optionsNeedsAccessTitle.message: Decant is on for $host$, but Chrome no longer has an access grant for it, so nothing can run there.
optionsNeedsAccessTitle.description: Tooltip explaining why a site shows the "needs access" button.

optionsRulesHeading.message: What happens to each file type
optionsRulesHeading.description: Heading of the section listing the routing rules.

optionsRulesHint.message: Files are matched top-down by extension or MIME type; the first enabled rule wins and anything unmatched is sent untouched. A companion / endpoint rule POSTs the file to a local service; an in-browser rule can also escalate to one — but only when the browser finds no text (a scan).
optionsRulesHint.description: Explanation under the "What happens to each file type" heading.

optionsRulesMatchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the box for the file extensions / MIME types a new rule matches. The examples are literal file-format identifiers and stay untranslated.

optionsRemoveRule.description: Tooltip on the ✕ button that removes a routing rule.

optionsRuleOnEmpty.description: Appended to a rule's summary when it escalates elsewhere on finding no text. $action$ is one of the actionInbrowser/actionPassthrough/actionCompanion/actionHttp labels.

optionsWarnRemoteTitle.message: This endpoint is not localhost — matching files leave your machine.
optionsWarnRemoteTitle.description: Tooltip on the ⚠ shown beside a rule that sends documents off the user's own machine.

actionInbrowser.description: Routing action: convert the file with the built-in engines, locally.

actionPassthrough.description: Routing action: leave the file untouched.

actionCompanion.description: Routing action: send the file to the optional helper program running on the user's own machine.

actionHttp.description: Routing action: send the file to a user-configured URL.

optionsOnEmptyLabel.message: If the browser finds no text (a scan):
optionsOnEmptyLabel.description: Label for the choice of what to do when a document turns out to be a scan with no readable text.

optionsOnEmptyNone.description: Escalation choice: do nothing further, send the original file.

optionsOnEmptyCompanion.description: Escalation choice: hand the scan to the local helper program, which can read it with OCR.

optionsOnEmptyHttp.description: Escalation choice: hand the scan to a user-configured URL.

optionsEndpointPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the box for a rule's destination URL. The example URL stays as-is.

optionsResponseFieldPlaceholder.message: responseField — JSON key holding the text, e.g. text (blank = raw body, as /convert-raw returns)
optionsResponseFieldPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the box naming which JSON key of the endpoint's reply holds the converted text. "responseField" is a config key name and stays as-is.

optionsJsonHeading.description: Heading of the section holding the whole configuration as editable JSON.

optionsJsonHint.message: Power users: the whole config (hosts, rules, hotkey) as editable JSON. Rule fields beyond the form above — output name/type, error fallback, request encoding — are available here.
optionsJsonHint.description: Explanation under the "Config as JSON" heading.

optionsJsonPlaceholder.message: Click “Show current” to load the active config.
optionsJsonPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the empty JSON editor. The quoted text must match the optionsShowCurrent button label.

optionsShowCurrent.description: Button that loads the active configuration into the JSON editor.

optionsApplyJson.description: Button that saves the edited JSON as the new configuration.

optionsBehaviorHeading.description: Heading of the section holding conversion preferences.

optionsAmbiguousLabel.message: When a document is text plus charts/images:
optionsAmbiguousLabel.description: Label for the default action on a document Decant can't classify confidently.

ambiguousAsk.description: Default for an unclear document: show the in-page prompt every time.

ambiguousConvert.description: Default for an unclear document: convert it, accepting that the charts and images are dropped.

ambiguousFigures.description: Default for an unclear document: convert it and attach its charts and images as separate files.

ambiguousCompanion.description: Default for an unclear document: send it to the local helper program, which can keep the visuals.

ambiguousOriginal.description: Default for an unclear document: don't convert, upload the file as it is.

optionsAmbiguousHint.message: The in-page prompt's “Set as default” checkbox changes this too. A choice that isn't possible for a file (no companion endpoint configured, no extractable figures) falls back to asking.
optionsAmbiguousHint.description: Explanation under the unclear-document default. The quoted text must match the promptRemember label.

optionsShowSavingsLabel.message: Show the estimated token-savings badge after a conversion
optionsShowSavingsLabel.description: Checkbox label for the badge reporting how many tokens a conversion saved.

optionsCaptureHeading.description: Heading of the section about converting the page the user is reading.

optionsCaptureHint.message: The toolbar button (or %s) converts the page you're reading to Markdown and attaches it in the chat you last used — the right-click menu picks a different chat. Reading the page needs no new site permissions: the click itself grants one-time access to that tab.
optionsCaptureHint.description: Explanation under the "Page capture" heading. %s marks where the keyboard shortcut is shown in a styled box — keep it in the sentence, and put it where the shortcut reads naturally in your language.

optionsCaptureShortcut.description: The page-capture keyboard shortcut, as printed on the options page. Translate the modifier names only if your locale's browser prints them differently.

optionsCaptureFiguresLabel.message: Also attach the page's images (up to 5; ones the page can't share stay as links)
optionsCaptureFiguresLabel.description: Checkbox label for attaching a captured page's images alongside its text.

optionsTokensHeading.description: Heading of the section showing the running total of tokens saved.

optionsTokensHint.message: Estimated total across every converted upload whose message was actually sent — drafts you abandoned don't count. An estimate for the same reasons the badge is one (~4 characters/token, a conservative per-page image cost).

optionsTokensZero.description: The saved-tokens total before anything has been converted.

optionsTokensCount.description: The saved-tokens total. Deliberately approximate — the ~ should survive translation.

optionsTokensUnavailable.description: Shown in place of the saved-tokens total when it can't be read from storage.

optionsResetCounter.description: Button that sets the saved-tokens total back to zero.

optionsHotkeyHeading.description: Heading of the section binding the shortcut that skips conversion once.

optionsHotkeyHint.message: Press this before attaching a file to send the next upload untouched (skips conversion).

optionsHotkeyChange.description: Button that starts recording a new key combination.

optionsHotkeyRecording.description: Label the "Change…" button takes on while it waits for the new key combination.

optionsBugHeading.description: Heading of the section linking to the project's issue tracker.

optionsBugHint.message: Found something broken? This opens a new GitHub issue with a template and your Decant version and browser prefilled — review it before submitting.
optionsBugHint.description: Explanation under the "Report a bug" heading.

optionsBugButton.description: Button that opens a prefilled new issue on GitHub.

optionsReset.description: Button that discards all settings and restores the shipped defaults.

statusSaveFailed.description: Shown when the browser refused to store the changed settings.

statusAccessGranted.description: Shown after the user re-grants a site's missing permission.

statusPermissionDeclined.description: Shown when the user dismisses the browser's permission prompt for a site.

statusHostEnabled.description: Shown after a site is switched on.

statusHostDisabled.description: Shown after a site is switched off.

statusHostRemoved.description: Shown after a site is deleted from the list.

statusInvalidHost.message: Enter a valid host, e.g. example.com
statusInvalidHost.description: Shown when the typed site name isn't a domain. "example.com" is a reserved example domain and stays as-is.

statusHostAlreadyListed.description: Shown when the typed site is already in the list.

statusHostAdded.description: Shown after a new site is added and its permission granted.

statusHostAddedDeclined.message: Added $host$ (permission declined — toggle it on to grant).
statusHostAddedDeclined.description: Shown after a new site is added but its permission was declined, so it can't run yet.

statusRuleEnabled.description: Shown after a routing rule is switched on.

statusRuleDisabled.description: Shown after a routing rule is switched off.

statusRuleRemoved.description: Shown after a routing rule is deleted.

statusNeedMatch.message: Enter at least one extension or MIME type to match.
statusNeedMatch.description: Shown when a new rule was submitted without anything for it to match.

statusNeedEndpoint.message: This needs an endpoint URL (http:// or https://).
statusNeedEndpoint.description: Shown when a rule that posts files somewhere was submitted without a destination URL.

statusUngrantableEndpoint.message: Chrome can't grant access to a plain http:// endpoint on another machine. Use https://, or run the endpoint on localhost.
statusUngrantableEndpoint.description: Shown when the destination URL is one the browser can never permit — unencrypted HTTP to another machine.

confirmRemoteEndpoint.message:
$endpoint$ is not localhost — files matching this rule will leave your machine.

Add the rule anyway?
confirmRemoteEndpoint.description: Confirmation before adding a rule that sends documents off the user's own machine.

statusRuleAdded.description: Shown after a routing rule is created.

statusRuleAddedDeclined.message: Rule added — endpoint permission declined, so matching files use the fallback until it's granted.
statusRuleAddedDeclined.description: Shown after a rule is created but the browser permission for its destination was declined.

statusRuleShadowed.message: Rule added, but an earlier enabled rule already handles $type$, so this one won't run until you remove or disable the earlier one.
statusRuleShadowed.description: Shown after a rule is created that an earlier rule already covers, so it can never take effect.

statusRuleShadowedType.description: Stands in for the file type in statusRuleShadowed when the shadowing rule names none.

statusJsonLoaded.message: Current config loaded below — edit and “Apply JSON”.
statusJsonLoaded.description: Shown after the active configuration is written into the JSON editor. The quoted text must match the optionsApplyJson button label.

statusInvalidJson.description: Shown when the text in the JSON editor doesn't parse.

error.example: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 42

confirmRemoteEndpoints.message:
This config sends matching files to non-localhost endpoints:

$endpoints$

Documents matching those rules will leave your machine. Apply anyway?
confirmRemoteEndpoints.description: Confirmation before applying pasted JSON that sends documents off the user's own machine. $endpoints$ is a newline-separated list of URLs.

statusConfigApplied.message: Config applied. Newly enabled hosts still need permission — toggle them to grant.
statusConfigApplied.description: Shown after pasted JSON is saved as the new configuration.

statusConfigAppliedDeclined.message: Config applied. Newly enabled hosts still need permission — toggle them to grant. Endpoint permission declined — those rules use their fallback.
statusConfigAppliedDeclined.description: Shown after pasted JSON is saved but the browser permission for its destinations was declined.

statusHotkeyNeedsModifier.message: Include Alt, Ctrl, or Cmd in the shortcut.
statusHotkeyNeedsModifier.description: Shown when the recorded key combination has no modifier, which would hijack ordinary typing. The modifier names are keyboard keys.

statusHotkeyUpdated.description: Shown after a new key combination is saved.

statusResetDone.description: Shown after all settings are restored to the shipped defaults.

statusSavingsOn.description: Shown after the token-savings badge is switched on.

statusSavingsOff.description: Shown after the token-savings badge is switched off.

statusCaptureFiguresOn.description: Shown after page captures are set to include the page's images.

statusCaptureFiguresOff.description: Shown after page captures are set to leave the page's images out.

statusAmbiguousAsk.description: Shown after unclear documents are set to ask every time.

statusAmbiguousSaved.description: Shown after a fixed action for unclear documents is chosen.

statusStatsResetFailed.description: Shown when the saved-tokens total couldn't be cleared.

statusStatsReset.description: Shown after the saved-tokens total is cleared.

promptDialogLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the in-page panel asking what to do with a document.

promptTitleOne.message: “$name$” looks like text with charts or images
promptTitleOne.description: Title of the in-page prompt for a single document.

promptTitleMany.message: $count$ documents look like text with charts or images
promptTitleMany.description: Title of the in-page prompt when several documents were attached at once. $count$ is always 2 or more.

promptVisualsOne.description: How many charts or images conversion would drop, when there is exactly one. Appears inside promptDetailCompanion / promptDetailFigures / promptDetailPlain.

promptVisualsMany.description: How many charts or images conversion would drop. $count$ is always 2 or more. Appears inside promptDetailCompanion / promptDetailFigures / promptDetailPlain.

promptVisualsUnknown.description: Stands in for a count of charts or images when the number isn't known. Appears inside promptDetailCompanion / promptDetailFigures / promptDetailPlain.

promptDetailCompanion.message: Converting to text saves tokens but drops $visuals$. The local companion can convert it and keep them, or send the original untouched.
promptDetailCompanion.description: Body of the in-page prompt when the local helper program is available for this file type. $visuals$ is one of promptVisualsOne / promptVisualsMany / promptVisualsUnknown.

promptDetailFigures.message: Converting to Markdown drops $visuals$ from the text — but they can ride along: attach the document's images as separate files next to the Markdown.
promptDetailFigures.description: Body of the in-page prompt when the document's figures can be attached alongside. $visuals$ is one of promptVisualsOne / promptVisualsMany / promptVisualsUnknown.

promptDetailPlain.message: Converting to Markdown saves tokens but drops $visuals$. Send the original to keep them.
promptDetailPlain.description: Body of the in-page prompt when converting is the only alternative to sending the original. $visuals$ is one of promptVisualsOne / promptVisualsMany / promptVisualsUnknown.

promptChoiceCompanion.description: Button: send the document to the local helper program, which can keep its visuals.

promptChoiceFigures.description: Button: convert to Markdown and attach the document's charts and images as separate files.

promptChoiceConvertTextOnly.description: Button: convert to Markdown, dropping the visuals. Used when other convert buttons are also shown.

promptChoiceConvert.description: Button: convert to Markdown. Used when it is the only convert button.

promptChoiceOriginal.description: Button: don't convert, upload the file as it is.

promptRemember.message: Set as default (change anytime in Decant options)
promptRemember.description: Checkbox on the in-page prompt that saves the clicked choice as the standing default. Must match the quoted text in optionsAmbiguousHint.

badgePassthrough.description: Badge shown while the skip-conversion shortcut is armed.

badgePassthroughCancel.description: Clickable text on the skip-conversion badge. "Esc" is the keyboard key.

badgeConverting.description: Badge shown while a file is being converted.

badgeExtractingFigures.description: Badge shown while a document's charts and images are being pulled out into separate files. A visibly slower step than the text conversion before it, which is why it is named separately.

badgeSavings.description: Badge reporting how many tokens a conversion saved. Deliberately approximate — the ~ should survive translation.

badgeSavingsPercent.description: Badge reporting how many tokens a conversion saved, with the share of the total. Deliberately approximate — the ~ should survive translation.

badgeSavingsEstimate.description: Short marker on the savings badge flagging the figure as an estimate. Abbreviation of "estimated".

noticeAttachFailedOne.message: Decant couldn't attach “$name$” — please re-attach using the site's file picker (+/attach button).
noticeAttachFailedOne.description: Shown when the converted file couldn't be handed to the chat page, e.g. because the page re-rendered mid-conversion.

noticeAttachFailedMany.message: Decant couldn't attach $count$ files — please re-attach using the site's file picker (+/attach button).
noticeAttachFailedMany.description: Shown when several converted files couldn't be handed to the chat page. $count$ is always 2 or more.

noticeUnconvertedDrop.message: Decant: use the file picker to convert — drag-and-drop can't be substituted here.
noticeUnconvertedDrop.description: Shown on sites where a dragged-in file is uploaded unconverted because there is nothing to substitute it through. Narrow pill with a single line: keep the actionable part first, it may be cut off at the end.

noticeUnconvertedPaste.message: Decant: use the file picker to convert — paste can't be substituted here.
noticeUnconvertedPaste.description: Shown on sites where a pasted file is uploaded unconverted because there is nothing to substitute it through. Narrow pill with a single line: keep the actionable part first, it may be cut off at the end.

menuCaptureTo.description: Right-click menu item that converts this page and sends it to a named chat. "Decant" is used as a verb — the product name doubles as the action.

menuCaptureToParent.description: Right-click submenu holding one entry per enabled chat. "Decant" is used as a verb — the product name doubles as the action.

menuIncludeImages.description: Right-click checkbox controlling whether a captured page's images are attached with its text.

noticeAlreadyChat.message: Decant: capture works on content pages — this is already a chat.
noticeAlreadyChat.description: Shown when the user tries to capture a chat site into itself.

noticeForcedHostUngranted.message: Decant: $host$ is enabled but Decant was never granted access to it — re-enable it in Decant's options, then retry.
noticeForcedHostUngranted.description: Shown when the chosen chat is switched on but has no browser permission, so it could never receive the page.

noticeCapturing.description: Shown on the page being captured, right after the user clicks.

noticeCaptureFailed.description: Shown when reading or converting the page failed.

error.example: Cannot access contents of the page

noticeNoGrantedTarget.message: Decant: no enabled chat site has been granted access — re-enable one in Decant's options.
noticeNoGrantedTarget.description: Shown when chat sites are switched on but none has browser permission, so none can receive the page.

noticeNoEnabledTarget.message: Decant: no chat sites are enabled — enable one in Decant's options.
noticeNoEnabledTarget.description: Shown when no chat site is switched on, so there is nowhere to send the page.

noticeSending.description: Shown while the converted page is on its way to the chat.

noticeDelivered.description: Shown when the converted page reached the chat.

noticeDeliveredWithImages.description: Shown when the converted page reached the chat together with its images.

noticeDeliveredImagesSkipped.message: Decant: delivered "$name$" to $target$ — its images couldn't be read from the page, so they stay as links.
noticeDeliveredImagesSkipped.description: Shown when the converted page reached the chat but its images were asked for and none could be read. Without this the toggle looks like it did nothing.

noticeNoInputClipboard.message: Decant: this chat takes no file attachments — the page's Markdown is on your clipboard, paste it into the composer.
noticeNoInputClipboard.description: Shown on the chat page itself when it accepts no files, so the text went to the clipboard instead.

noticeNoInputClipboardFailed.message: Decant: this chat takes no file attachments, and the clipboard copy failed — capture again once this tab is focused.
noticeNoInputClipboardFailed.description: Shown on the chat page itself when it accepts no files and the clipboard fallback also failed.

noticeNoInputSource.message: Decant: $target$ takes no file attachments — the page's Markdown is on your clipboard instead.
noticeNoInputSource.description: Shown back on the captured page when the chat accepts no files, so the text went to the clipboard.

noticeNoInputSourceFailed.message: Decant: $target$ takes no file attachments, and the clipboard copy failed — see that tab.
noticeNoInputSourceFailed.description: Shown back on the captured page when the chat accepts no files and the clipboard fallback also failed.

noticeDeliveryFailed.message: Decant: captured, but couldn't deliver to $host$ — $reason$
noticeDeliveryFailed.description: Shown when the page converted but never reached the chat. $reason$ is one of the deliver* messages.

captureBlockedInternal.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeCaptureFailed, for a chrome://-style page the browser never lets extensions read. Lowercase — it continues a sentence.

captureBlockedGallery.message: the extension gallery can't be captured
captureBlockedGallery.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeCaptureFailed, for the browser's own extension store pages, where scripting is blocked. Lowercase — it continues a sentence.

captureScriptMissing.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeCaptureFailed, for when the injected capture code never defined itself on the page. Lowercase — it continues a sentence.

captureNoResult.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeCaptureFailed, for when the injection ran but nothing came back. Lowercase — it continues a sentence.

captureNothingToConvert.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeCaptureFailed, for a page with no prose to turn into Markdown. $reason$ is an internal engine code such as "no-text" — leave it untranslated. Lowercase — it continues a sentence.

deliverCouldNotOpen.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeDeliveryFailed, for when a tab for the chat couldn't be opened. Lowercase — it continues a sentence.

deliverNoAnswer.message: $host$ never answered — is Decant enabled (and granted) for it?
deliverNoAnswer.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeDeliveryFailed, for when the chat tab never responded.

deliverFailed.description: Reason phrase, shown inside noticeDeliveryFailed, for a failure the chat page reported without a reason. Lowercase — it continues a sentence.

commonDismiss.description: Screen-reader name of the ✕ button that closes a badge or panel.
